nora-cs: Quick heads-up 10am demo tomorrow for Helios Biotech. Dry-run showed p95 spikes from CA region. They asked for a short regional allowlist + a temporary rate lift in ca-central-1 and eu-north-1. Renewal review in 10 days, customer asked for a stable pilot.
james-ops: Can do. Drop CIDRs + expected QPS and any partner vendors.
nora-cs: Helios provided `198.51.200.12/32`. Partner analytics vendor SynapseMetrics wants `198.51.201.0/24`. They expect bursts up to ~900 qps for 20m, steady 180 qps.
maya-net: Proposal: AL-HE-2026 with TTL 10h auto-revoke, TEMP_BURST_10H policy capped at 1200 qps, burst window 25m, pinned to ca-central-1 & eu-north-1. I'll pre-warm KV/embeddings after apply. Need sec approval for vendor CIDR.
riley-sec: Require AUP and a vendor contact. SynapseMetrics must attest TLS + cert rotation. 10h TTL OK. Add audit entry to CS-12988.
ethan-ae: I'll prep an exec note and flag renewal watch. Recommend 15m runbook call 30m before demo.
james-ops: Plan to run at 09:30 UTC to warm caches. Commands:
```
POST /admin/allowlists
{"name":"AL-HE-2026","cidrs":["198.51.200.12/32","198.51.201.0/24"],"ttl":"10h","auto_revoke":true}
POST /policies/rate
{"name":"TEMP_BURST_10H","max_qps":1200,"burst_window_sec":1500,"regions":["ca-central-1","eu-north-1"]}
```
infra-bot: allowlist AL-HE-2026 scheduled by james-ops at 2026-07-08T09:30:00Z
maya-net: LGTM. Kicking cache warm and pre-populating common prompt prefixes.
riley-sec: Approve once SynapseMetrics contact and AUP uploaded to CS-12988. If any anomalous traffic revoke immediately.
james-ops: Applied. AL in place and routing pinned. Initial smoke shows p95 in ca-central-1 dropped from 310ms -> 82ms. No errors.
nora-cs: Demo complete 1 execs pleased. Sustained peak ~860 qps for 12m. SynapseMetrics asked for a 3h ephemeral add for `198.51.202.0/24` to finish batch analytics. Can we do 3h?
riley-sec: 3h ephemeral OK with manual approval and scoped tokens. Post the CIDR in ticket and I'll sign off.
james-ops: Adding `198.51.202.0/24` TTL 3h, auto-revoke scheduled. AL-HE-2026 updated. Monitoring looks stable.
ethan-ae: Great news 1 renewal moved from watch -> healthy. I'll send NPS + latency pulse and update CRM with metrics.
nora-cs: Thanks team! I'll schedule the 1-week follow-up and attach the runbook notes to CS-12988.
